page.overview:
Who is Apago?

Apago was a Sith pureblood male who served the reconstituted Sith Empire as a Sith Lord during the Cold War. Apago became involved in a violent power struggle with a rival Sith Lord, Cyone, which escalated into open combat within the Sith Sanctum on Dromund Kaas.

Lord Apago first appeared in the dynamic encounter mission "Sith Affairs," introduced in Game Update 7.7: Dynamic Worlds, released on May 28, 2025, as part of Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith, the eighth digital expansion to the massively multiplayer online role-playing game Star Wars: The Old Republic.
